fullContentHtml:
Indian Post Office GDS Recruitment 2026 - Apply Link Activated, Online Form Now Available - Complete Details

India Post has announced the Recruitment 2026 notification for 23757 GDS posts. The online application process will be conducted from 02 September 2026 to 19 September 2026. Eligible candidates can apply through the official website, indiapost.gov.in.

Important Dates

  • Registration Start Date : 31 August 2026
  • Notification Release Date : 20 August 2026
  • Last Date for Issue of Any Supplementary Shortlist : 31 December 2026 (engagement process closes after this date)

Application Fee

  • Posts : Branch Postmaster (BPM), Assistant Branch Postmaster (ABPM), Dak Sevak
  • Registration Start Date : 31 August 2026
  • Online One-Time Registration (OTR) : 31.08.2026 to 19.09.2026 (up to 1700 hrs)
  • Submission of Online Applications and Fee Payment : 02.09.2026 to 21.09.2026 (up to 1700 hrs)
  • Edit/Correction Window (Registration/Application Forms, including online fee payment if applicable) : 23.09.2026 to 24.09.2026 (up to 1700 hrs)
  • Last Date for Issue of Any Supplementary Shortlist : 31 December 2026 (engagement process closes after this date)
  • North Eastern Circle : 2,614
  • Rajasthan Circle : 1,009
  • West Bengal Circle : 1,762
  • Post Name : Brief Role
  • Branch Postmaster (BPM) : Overall in-charge of a single-handed Branch Post Office (B.O.) - day-to-day postal operations, IPPB transactions, marketing/promotion of Department services, mail conveyance and delivery. Must arrange own accommodation for the Branch Post Office and reside in the post village.
  • Assistant Branch Postmaster (ABPM) : Assists the BPM - sale of stamps/stationery, mail conveyance and doorstep delivery, IPPB transactions; may perform combined BPM duties when required. Must reside within the delivery jurisdiction of the concerned Post Office.
  • Branch Postmaster (BPM) : ₹12,000/- to ₹29,380/-
  • Assistant Branch Postmaster (ABPM)/Dak Sevak : ₹10,000/- to ₹24,470/-
  • Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribe (SC/ST) : 5 years
  • Other Backward Classes (OBC) : 3 years
  • PwBD + OBC : 13 years
  • PwBD + SC/ST : 15 years

How to Apply Online

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the online application / registration link.
  3. Register with your basic details like name, email, mobile number.
  4. Fill the application form with personal, educational and address details.
  5. Upload scanned photograph, signature and required documents.
  6. Pay the application fee online.
  7. Submit the form and take a printout for future reference.
